items.title: Edgar "Sambo" Joseph Interview, 1960-08-07
items.q: You remember Tato? Oh, yeah. Point of that. Point of that. Point of that. Point of that. Altar. Altar, yeah. Had his blood on the piano.

ctx.x: They come up here to make money.

We ain't talking about them, man. We looking to make money like they're making. So, we made it on that. Turn around from that. They hired me. I played at the World Convention. I wish I had that picture to show you. I had a book of me. The whole village, I'll tell you who was playing with me. Boy was like John Cleo. You remember Cleo? He played bass? Oh, yeah. He played with Howard. He had Cleo. You remember Tato? Oh, yeah. Point of that. Point of that. Point of that. Point of that. Altar. Altar, yeah. Had his…
If you want to stop at any time, go ahead. No, wait, I was at Valor.
